name: tier1
title: Tier-1 agents
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: New Claude agent and New Pi agent (tier 1), each with vqro's inbox plugin wired for that launch only.
description: Starts Claude Code or Pi in a new terminal tab with vqro's pull plugin: Claude Code through --settings with a per-launch hooks file, Pi through -e with the installed plugin. Your ~/.claude and ~/.pi are never read or written. Each agent gets a fresh principal, its plugin's pull declaration and a receive grant, its request route is recorded as human, and its inbox is resumed (your click is the intent). Turn it off to remove these launch commands; running agents keep running as plain terminals.
